summary: The run (analysis_id 746bfa23117c842e696c98ae1b348a4f3e4454b44edb6d3dce5f5ea68719dd0d) is VALID but analysis coverage is INCOMPLETE (reasons: CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED, CAPACITY_STAGE_NOT_VERIFIED). Policy verdict is NO_POLICY — this is not a PASS. The capacity summary is INDETERMINATE: capacity_knee is null because the knee detector was not implemented (KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED), and no capacity bound was set (lower_inclusive null, upper_exclusive null). The only stage, d16-cpu-limited-20users (target 20 users, achieved p05_10s = 20), is INDETERMINATE because the load generator jmeter-generator was CPU-throttled: the diagnostic policy check generator-cpu-throttle-ratio (gt 0.2) is FAIL, with throttle ratio mean 0.861, median 1.0, max 1.0, min 0.05 over 30 cells and a finding listing 27 cells in violation — so delivery of the intended 20-user load was not verified. The window policy summary verdict PASS reflects only the business error-rate policy (overall-errors lte 0.01 PASS, 0 errors / 38,842 in window); resource_verdict is NO_POLICY, so the window PASS must not be read as a capacity or resource pass. Clock alignment is not verified (not_verified_by_core), which limits temporal interpretation. No capacity or performance conclusion should be drawn until the stage is re-run with an unthrottled generator, clock alignment is verified, and a knee detector is implemented or a manual bound analysis is performed.

hypotheses.observation: The resource policy check generator-cpu-throttle-ratio (operator gt, threshold 0.2) on jmeter-generator status is FAIL, and the cfs_throttled_period_ratio series shows max 1, mean 0.8610030984778667, median 1, q25 0.955188679245, min 0.05 over 30 cells; a finding records 27 cells in violation with observed_min 0.395833333333 and observed_max 1.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The load generator itself was CPU-throttled during most of the window, so it may not have dispatched requests at the intended 20-user rate; if real, the achieved p05 of 20 users reflects configured threads rather than verified delivered load, which would explain CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED and the stage verdict INDETERMINATE.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Re-run the stage with an unthrottled generator (more CPU allocation or reduced generator overhead) and confirm throttle ratio stays at or below 0.2 for every cell while verifying delivered request rate against the intended 20-user load.

hypotheses.observation: capacity_summary reports bound_type INDETERMINATE, capacity_knee null, knee_reason KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, lower_inclusive null, and upper_exclusive null.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: No knee detector ran, so no load level at which latency/throughput degrades was identified; the null knee and absent bounds are artifacts of pipeline implementation rather than evidence that the system has spare capacity or no saturation point.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Enable or implement the knee detector, or perform a manual breakpoint analysis across multiple verified load levels; until then treat capacity as unmeasured.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: The window PASS is determined by the business error-rate policy only; the SUT had no enforced resource policy and the diagnostic generator throttle failure did not fail the window, so this business PASS should not be interpreted as a capacity or resource PASS.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Add explicit resource policies for the SUT services and treat the window PASS as business-only until a resource verdict is established; separately enforce (non-diagnostic) the generator capacity guard.

recommendations.action: Report the outcome as NO_POLICY / INDETERMINATE rather than PASS: state that no capacity bound is established and that the window PASS is business error-rate only.

caveats: No capacity bound is established: bound_type INDETERMINATE, capacity_knee null, lower_inclusive null, upper_exclusive null; NO_POLICY is not a PASS.

The window policy summary verdict PASS derives only from the business error-rate policy (overall-errors lte 0.01 PASS, 0 errors / 38,842 in window); resource_verdict is NO_POLICY and the generator throttle check is effect 'diagnostic', so the throttle FAIL did not fail the window.

Clock alignment is not_verified_by_core, so no lead/lag, ordering, or temporal causal relationship between resource throttling and latency is supported by this run.

Zero error counts (0 across 47,396 samples overall and per transaction) do not prove stability, spare capacity, or absence of functional issues; the SUT had no resource policies, so SUT saturation is not assessed.
The throttle violation finding covers 27 of 30 cells (from_epoch_ms 1790627160000 to_epoch_ms 1790627430000); the evidence does not state why the remaining cells are excluded.
Knee detection was not implemented (KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED); a non-detected or flat knee is not evidence of stability or spare capacity, only of pipeline configuration.
